ports.label: Multiviewer Out (HDMI 2.0 version; a DP 1.2 version exists)
Dante Primary/Secondary
ports.note: 64x64 Dante channels @48 kHz, AES67; redundant Ethernet ports

ports.label: MCO 5-pin (On/Off, 2x GPI, 8x GPO)
ports.note: 1x On/Off, 2x GPI, 8x GPO across 3 connectors (per user manual)

slots.label: Input card slots (field-swappable, not hot-swappable)
slots.note: 8 or 16 4K60p inputs via 2 or 4 cards. Cards available: 4x HDMI 2.0, 8x HDMI 1.4, 4x DP 1.2, 4x 12G-SDI, 4x 12G-SDI + 1x 2.5GbE NDI, 4x SFP+, 4x Optical Fiber, 4x SDVoE

slots.label: Output card slots (field-swappable)
slots.note: Up to 16 active 4K60p outputs. Latest datasheet says 6 output cards; older datasheet says 4. Cards available: 4x HDMI 2.0, 4x DP 1.2, 4x 12G-SDI, 4x SFP+, 4x Optical Fiber, 4x SDVoE
